upstream.sha_note: master HEAD at pin time, deliberately NOT the newest tag. v1.1.2 is dated 2024-12-21; master carries nine further months of work, including `feat!: update parser to ABI 15` (the ABI tree-sitter 0.25 emits) and `ci: update corpus to Zig 0.15.1`. Pinning the tag would pin a grammar that predates both the ABI and the language era this oracle adjudicates. Submodule pointers are commits, so this is a commit either way.

generate_cli_note: same pin as the other grammars: tree-sitter-cli 0.26.x ships broken Unicode identifier tables (see treebank-rust ledger)

patches.title: treebank redistribution notice
patches.origin: treebank; README warning that this tree is a generated, patched redistribution (treebank.dev), applied first so every materialized tree carries it

patches.title: treebank crate identity
patches.origin: treebank; upstream owns the tree-sitter-zig name on crates.io, so the redistribution publishes under its own: package name, repository, homepage and description. [lib] name stays tree_sitter_zig so the crate is a drop-in replacement. include gains LOCAL-PATCHES.md, ledger.json and patches/* so provenance travels inside the published tarball. Cargo.lock carries the matching rename and nothing else — dependency versions stay upstream_s. The published version string is deliberately NOT here: publish.sh derives it from crates.io at publish time. See PUBLISHING.md.
patches.note: The Cargo.lock hunk is hand-produced against upstream_s committed blob rather than taken from `git -C build diff`. tree-sitter-zig force-tracks Cargo.lock while its own .gitignore ignores it, so materialize.sh_s throwaway build repo never stages the file and a diff there would silently come back empty. `git apply` is unaffected — it patches the working tree, not the index — so verify.sh reconstructs the file correctly.
